reviews.title: AI reads books, I’d rather listen to the satnav!
reviews.text:
I was looking forward to some informed content and a summarised version of some great non-fiction books, however all this has is a droningly obvious AI voice reading in monotony. This makes it hard to listen to, especially when it gets the intonation wrong.
It would work well if it was read by human voices. 
Unfortunately it just seems like a cheap way to make money by getting some chat bot to summarise a book and sound it.
I’d rather listen to the satnav!

reviews.title: Predatory app
reviews.text: This is a very predatory app. It makes you pay or get a three-day free trial but if you get a free trial, it doesn’t offer it through the normal App Store subscription model, it takes you to a payment page. So if you’re like me and always cancel a trial immediately so you won’t forget, whether you decide to keep the app or not, it’s not available in your apple subscriptions to cancel. And it’s not just that, immediately after paying it took me to a page where it wanted me to pay for a $24 ebook. If I hadn’t been paying attention, it would have been very easy to assume it was another bright blue button I needed to click to finalize my subscription. And that of course is exactly what they’re hoping for. Then they’re hoping it’s hard enough to find out how to cancel that you don’t bother and get charged. For the cherry on top, once I figured out how to cancel directly with them, it wouldn’t let me access the premium content. Normally apps let you do so through the duration of your trial, but it just asked for the premium cost again. All because I wanted to try to listen to what was apparently an 8 min audio course. So far all that time and frustration, I didn’t access a single thing. Also, all of their emails went to spam… and rightly so.

reviews.title: Non-existent Customer Support
reviews.text: After I purchased a one month trial of Headway, I was asked a series of questions- basically if I thought certain titles would be interesting. Bc I hadn’t used Headway in years, when they asked if I wanted to add them, I clicked yes thinking whatever they sound good- assuming that it was apart of it. Like I said I wasn’t familiar with the App nor are most people who would be in this scenario. Then I got an alert I had been charged an additional $20 extra dollars. I was confused bc I thought I had purchased only the one month subscription. So I reached out to “customer service” and they “kindly informed” me that they can’t charge me for anything o didn’t agree to purchase and closed the case. So I attempted again to get in touch with customer service to request a refund bc it was a misunderstanding & I wasn’t going to use the service. When I submitted it, I got a message saying it wasn’t submitted that I have to verify my email address. So I check my email- nothing and honestly I don’t think I’m going to get an email. They don’t have a phone number or a real point of contact and it’s probably because they make a lot of money on confusing people with add-ons and they can get away with it. I hope the $20 they made off of me is worth it bc I am gladly going to spread the word about their lack of integrity and customer support.

reviews.title: It literally won’t let me cancel my subscription

The subscription did not show up in my Apple ID subscriptions, so I had to go to the website. After needing to change my password after trying all my usual passwords, I finally logged in and went to “Manage Subscriptions”. Then my screen would just go white every time I tried. Refreshing the page didn’t work either. This is very frustrating because I have to pay off my student loans soon so I don’t have the financial means to pay for the subscription any more. And honestly, the overall content of this app is disappointing too. I thought it was going to actually teach me how to actually manage my social anxiety and feel better about myself, when instead it just wants to teach me how to invest and hookup with women.

reviews.title: Promising app ruined by sneaky charges
reviews.text: As others have said, the app asks at set up stage if you want additional features such as infographics, at a point where you’re into a groove of answering loads of questions, and by clicking yes you are immediately charge again. There is no prior warning to say “by clicking yes you accept an additional charge”. It’s a very sneaky way to extort more money. Customer Services then refuse refund on the premise you’ve accepted the T&Cs and that the charges are clear. THEY AREN’T! This left a bad first impression and even though I attempted to cancel my subscription immediately because of this, I can see my bank just intercepted and blocked a new subscription charge! Thank you Monzo! The app itself was quite useful but ruined by misleading charges, poor customer service experience, and a problematic cancellation process.

reviews.title: Hidden charges and misleading reoccurring charges
reviews.text:
I had a very poor experience with this app due to misleading purchase flows and unauthorized recurring charges.

In July 2025, I subscribed at a discounted rate. During setup, I was shown an option for an infographics feature. The wording was misleading — I only intended to view information about it, not purchase it — yet I was charged anyway. When I contacted support immediately, I was told a refund was impossible because their system showed I had “authorized” the add-on, which I did not.

To make matters worse, the infographics feature is not clearly accessible within the app, and this limitation was never disclosed during the preview or purchase screen.

In January 2026, I discovered I had been charged £45 for a three-month renewal that I did not knowingly sign up for. The subscription continued recurring without clear notification, resulting in over £100 charged across roughly six months.

Despite escalating this issue, the company refused to issue any refund.

I would strongly caution prospective users to read every screen carefully and monitor their billing closely. Transparency and consent around pricing and renewals need serious improvement.

reviews.title: Bad First Impression
reviews.text: After clicking on an add for this app and completing the questionnaire, which I thought was very promising, I signed up for a year’s subscription. The first issue was that in addition to the subscription I was charged immediately for an add-on (‘Infographics’) that was not clearly labelled as a charge. It was also hard to find more information about this charge or add-on, this wasn’t visible in the app itself and instead I had to sign in using the browser after a confusing process of setting up (or resetting) my password. Generally the app is not very user friendly; it is not clear how ‘plans’ and recommendations are put together, and the content itself is very general, and a bit of a let down following the detailed questionnaire. Finally, when I wrote to customer service about wanting to cancel my annual subscription to avoid being charged automatically (I read that this happened to users before) I was sent a one-line reply saying they couldn’t find my subscription. In summary, I probably would not recommend this app; the sign-up process and billing side of things felt dishonest and so far the content has been underwhelming.

reviews.title: Headway won’t stop bugging me to resubscribe / I’m going to Blinkist
reviews.text:
I canceled my Headway subscription, but the app refuses to accept it. Every single time I open the app, a giant “PLAN CONTINUE” banner slaps across the top of my screen like I somehow owe them more money. My subscription is canceled. It clearly says it is canceled. Yet Headway keeps acting like I should renew it anyway. It feels dishonest and incredibly manipulative.

I tried everything. Logging out. Reinstalling. Restarting my phone. Double checking my Apple subscription settings. Nothing stops this obnoxious banner from reappearing. The only way to get rid of it is to delete the app completely, which tells you exactly how Headway operates. They can’t take “no” for an answer unless you physically remove the app from your device.

No other app I use behaves this way. Most companies respect a cancellation. Headway turns it into a guilt trip and a nagging contest. If this is how they treat paying customers, I can only imagine what else they cut corners on. I’m done with it, and I’m warning others so they don’t get stuck dealing with this never ending cycle!
